content: Pregnant individuals diagnosed with either type 1 or type 2 diabetes should be advised to take a low-dose aspirin regimen, specifically 100 to 150 mg per day, beginning between 12 and 16 weeks of gestation. This intervention is recommended to reduce the risk of developing preeclampsia. If a dosage of 162 mg per day is deemed appropriate and available, it may also be used. Alternatively, if 162 mg or 100–150 mg tablets are not accessible, an 81 mg tablet can be considered as a viable option.
